self.title: Cycle 3 · Investigating Levels of Information Activity and Persistent Identity

detail.title: Investigating Levels of Information Activity and Persistent Identity
detail.summary: This cycle continues the investigation into memory and persistent identity within project proj-memory-identity-01, utilizing collected source evidence regarding the multi-level architecture of information activity.

detail.title: Memory versus Persistent Identity
detail.question: What distinguishes a system that remembers its past from one that has developed a persistent identity?
detail.reason: The project remains active and requires investigation into the specific mechanisms that bridge memory storage and subjective identity formation.
